name: Maya & Dan
primary_objection: We need to think about it.
trust_unlock: Ask how the dogs use the yard and what clean-up problem they want solved.
spouse_status: Both spouses are present and share the decision.
same_day_close_condition: Show how the base, drainage and pet infill solve their specific concern; present full scope, financing and ask for the business.

triggers.line: How will this handle the dogs and odor?
What happens underneath the turf when it rains?
We like it, but should we think about it first?

scenarios.title: The muddy dog yard
scenarios.priority: Two large dogs track mud into the kitchen.
scenarios.constraint: Keep a safe path to the back door during installation.
scenarios.opening: Thanks for coming. We want to do something about this backyard.

scenarios.title: The shaded corner
scenarios.priority: A dog repeatedly uses a shaded corner and odor is the biggest concern.
scenarios.opening: We need a yard that works better for our dog.

scenarios.title: A yard for kids and dogs
scenarios.priority: Children and dogs need a clean shared play area.
scenarios.constraint: One low spot collects water after rain.
scenarios.opening: We want to spend more time out here as a family.
